items.title: DETOUR: An Interactive Benchmark for Dual-Agent Search and Reasoning
items.title_zh: DETOUR：面向双智能体搜索与推理的交互式基准
items.summary: DETOUR is a dual-agent benchmark of 1,011 prompts for tip-of-the-tongue search, in which a primary agent must identify a remembered entity by querying a consistent memory agent. Current state-of-the-art models reportedly reach only 36% accuracy across text, image, audio and video, highlighting weakness in underspecified retrieval.

items.title: Agentic Framework for Epidemiological Modeling
items.title_zh: 流行病学建模的智能体框架
items.summary: EPIAGENT is an agentic framework that synthesizes, calibrates, verifies and refines epidemiological simulators by treating disease progression as iterative program synthesis. A key design choice is an explicit epidemiological flow-graph intermediate representation that enables modular correctness checks before code generation; case studies reportedly show it captures complex growth dynamics and produces consistent counterfactual projections.

items.title: KEPO: Knowledge-Enhanced Preference Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning with Applications to Medical VQA
items.title_zh: KEPO：面向多模态推理的知识增强偏好优化及其在医学视觉问答中的应用
items.summary: KEPO is a post-training framework that combines quality-gated on-policy distillation with knowledge-enhanced exploration, applying teacher guidance only to high-quality trajectories. On a medical visual question answering benchmark it reportedly showed improved training stability and out-of-distribution performance over RL and distillation baselines.

items.title: Clause-Internal or Clause-External? Testing Turkish Reflexive Binding in Adapted versus Chain of Thought Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 从句内还是从句外？在适配型与思维链大语言模型中检验土耳其语反身代词约束
items.summary: The study tests whether state-of-the-art LLMs capture Turkish reflexive binding using 100 balanced sentences that pit local against non-local antecedents for kendi and kendisi. Trendyol-LLM-7B favored local bindings in about 70% of trials, while OpenAI's o1 Mini distributed choices nearly evenly, suggesting weaker sensitivity to locality in this configuration.

items.title: Bridging the Semantic Chasm: Synergistic Conceptual Anchoring for Generalized Few-Shot and Zero-Shot OOD Perception
items.title_zh: 跨越语义鸿沟：面向广义少样本与零样本 OOD 感知的协同概念锚定
items.summary: The paper presents SynerNet, a multi-agent framework with four specialized units for visual perception, linguistic context, nominal embedding and global coordination that exchange messages to counter cross-modal alignment degeneration in vision-language models on out-of-distribution concepts. On the VISTA-Beyond benchmark it reports precision improvements of 1.2% to 5.4% in few-shot and zero-shot settings.

items.title: Autonomous Data Processing using Meta-Agents
items.title_zh: 使用元智能体的自主数据处理
items.summary: ADP-MA is a framework that dynamically constructs, executes and iteratively refines data-processing pipelines through hierarchical agent orchestration. Meta-agents analyze data and task specifications to design multi-phase plans, instantiate ground-level agents and monitor performance, with context-aware optimization, adaptive workload partitioning and reuse of previously designed agents.

items.title: callstack/agent-device
items.title_zh: agent-device：面向 AI 编程代理的移动应用自动化工具
items.summary: A toolkit for mobile app automation and verification by AI coding agents, offering a CLI, an MCP server and a typed Node.js API across iOS, Android, HarmonyOS, TV, web, macOS and Linux.

items.title: Paramchoudhary/ResumeSkills
items.title_zh: ResumeSkills：面向求职的 AI Agent 技能集
items.summary: A collection of AI agent skills for resume optimization, job applications and career development, built so Claude Code can help with resume writing, ATS optimization, interview preparation and strategic job search.
